title: Pricing rules
description: Automate price adjustments by segment or product.

help.title: About pricing rules
help.overview: Pricing rules change prices automatically, before any discount code: wholesale prices, a sale on a category, or a surcharge. Each item in a cart gets at most one rule.

sections.title: Which rule applies
items: Rules are tried by priority, highest first; the first one that fits an item is the one it gets.
A rule works only while it's active and between its start and end dates.
A rule with customer groups applies only to signed-in customers in those groups.
Minimum order amount and minimum quantity look at the whole cart.

sections.title: What it does
items: A percentage or fixed discount, a fixed price, or a surcharge on top. A price never goes below zero.
It covers everything, or only chosen products, categories or collections; a category rule looks only at the product's first category.
The till sells at catalog prices and doesn't use pricing rules.
